correctness.rationale: Reconstructed each functional lambda through beta(X,Y)=lambda(XY), using unit beta(1,XY), then regrouped the Gram matrix by shared matrix-unit index j. The independent blocks H_j have shapes j by (n-j+1) and lie in overlapping corners of the coefficient matrix. A single central invertible m by m block gives all full row/column ranks for odd n; for even n the adjacent middle blocks share C, and full maximal ranks permit rank(C)=m or m−1 with the two extension vectors outside its image/row space. The counted cases yield the stated odd/even formulas and geometric exceptional loci. Checked n=3,4 for GF(2) by separately constructing the full literal Gram matrix for every functional (24/528 optimal forms), not by using the claimed block decomposition. The all-n and arbitrary-field assertions rest on the algebraic proof and determinantal geometry, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Independently tested only n=3,4 over GF(2); arbitrary n and extension fields rely on the analyzed determinant/rank decomposition.
